description: This file is an initialization module for the 'opt_einsum' backend in PyTorch, managing availability, configuration, and integration of the opt_einsum package for optimized tensor contractions.

classes.name: OptEinsumModule
classes.description: A class extending PropModule to manage the enabled state and strategy of opt_einsum, integrating with sys.modules for module replacement.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if the opt_einsum package is available and imported successfully.

methods.name: get_opt_einsum
methods.description: Returns the opt_einsum package if available, otherwise None.

methods.name: set_flags
methods.description: Sets the enabled state and strategy for opt_einsum, returning previous flags.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set enabled and strategy flags for opt_einsum.
